newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Rainbow Chicken gutted by profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Rainbow Chicken gutted by profit warning.

text.p: Shares in Rainbow Chicken Ltd slumped nine percent to a fresh year low of 70 cents as the struggling broiler producer warned yet again of big losses.
The company said in a statement earlier that it would report losses significantly higher than expected in the half-year to September.
"The announcement was unexpected. The reality of these losses have been around for some time but obviously people panic when they see the announcement and they sell it down," a trader said.
The dealer added that he expected the counter to recover slightly, possibly back up to the 77 cent level it started the day at.
